Known or basically known dates

  • **15 BP: **Naros falls; dryads transplanted
  • **10 BP: **Ser Gareth Lemarr disappears

**The City Falls: **The towers erode at the time that the first dragons broke the world like an egg with their birth

Alberon Becomes a God

Alberon Appears Frequently to His Citizens, and to Jarmond Eleven Times: Bergolast is a land of eternal ice in these days. Jarmond sent to Bergolast; is debased and fed Tarrasque blood.

Jarmond of the Knife is Thrown Down the Tarrasque’s Gullet: Then it “came to pass” that Tiamat was slain.

The Death of Tiamat; Alberon Scatters her Heads

**Alberon casts off She Who Waits: **At some point after slaying Tiamat. He also woos the Green Lady (whom he later divorces).

Bergolast Aflame: Jarmond is stabbed eleven times with eleven spears, sees Tarrasque, sees Bergolast burn, stabs self.

#Verdant Bergolast is Scorched, the Ground Shakes, the Keening Sea Shifts: Melnir’s Mount is created (51.12). This happened “long ago”.

#The People of the Claw Refuse to Evacuate from the Lava of Melnir’s Mount, Beginning their Separate Society

**The red head of Tiamat heats the south, turning icy Bergolast to the Burning Lands: **The gnolls disagree, attribute the scorching to their matrons copulating with efreet.

The Gnolls Come to the Shrouded Lands: Gnolls ruled by Great Chieftain, the Defiler. This occurred soon after the fall of Bergolast. Before this, the Defiler travelled to the Grey Mountains and ate some strange heart. (May have happened after the Shuttering)
